newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Semperit capital increase big hit - CAIB.
newsitem.headline: Semperit capital increase big hit - CAIB.

text.p: The capital increase of rubber products maker Semperit AG Holding attracted great investor interest which has lapped into the secondary market, lead manager Creditanstalt Investment Bank said on Tuesday.

During the subscription period that ended on Monday investors were offered 326,562 new ordinary shares with a nominal value of 100 schillings, raising Semperit's base capital to 293.9 million schillings from 261.25 million.
The price for the shares was fixed at 750 schillings -- a discount of 17 percent from the offering price. By 0829 GMT on Tuesday, the shares were trading at around 1,018 schillings.
Creditanstalt-Bankverein now holds 45 percent of the base capital, international institutional investors 30 percent, with the remaining 25 percent widely spread.
Last year, Semperit's pretax profit jumped 43 percent to 162 million schillings and net profit gained 19 percent to 120 million.
